ns2:course.label: Computing in the Humanities
ns2:course.description: Explores use and application of technology to scholarly activity in the humanities, including projects that put classic texts on the web or create multimedia application on humanities topics. Same as INFO 310. Prerequisite: Sophomore standing.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Same as INFO 310. Prerequisite: Sophomore standing.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing. Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Information Sciences department.
